title: ArcReel custom invocation endpoint · Declarative definition
description: Complete protocol description for the JSON in/out plus submit/poll family. JSON Schema governs structure only; arcreel_market_core.endpoint_definition.validator checks semantic rules such as placeholder references, the JSONPath subset, api_key scope, and capability consistency. Together they form the complete gate.

kind.description: Container kind. Accept only declarative; reject unknown kinds directly.

schema_version.description: Format version (semver) followed by this definition. Preserve the original value when storing; do not migrate.

media_type.description: Output media type, defaulting to video. Available template variables, asset sources, capability fields, and artifact-extraction keys form sets per media type, checked by the validator.

inputs.description: Asset-input declarations: encode request assets as values available to templates. Reference them as inputs.<name>; list-valued assets expand only through $each.

enum_maps.description: Enum-parameter dictionaries: keys are ArcReel-side values (stringified for lookup); values are provider-side values written to requests. The validator restricts eligible variables. Apply mappings consistently to URL, headers, auth.query, and body; a lookup miss raises an error without sending a request.

defaults.description: Parameter defaults: when callers leave a parameter unspecified (null), fill it from here before rendering, then apply enum_maps normally. The validator restricts eligible variables to parameters callers may omit (duration / aspect_ratio / resolution / generate_audio / seed). Defaults are ArcReel-side values, not provider-side values. Without a declaration, the parameter remains unspecified and whole-value placeholders still remove the entire field.

status_map.description: Map provider status strings to queued / running / succeeded / failed (matching ProviderJobStatus names). Stringify and lowercase original values before lookup. Declarative definitions do not produce expired; expiration maps to failed.

allOf.$comment: Video definitions must supply an artifact address: extract it from polling without a secondary retrieval section, or from result when present. The validator checks image artifact extraction by media type.

semver.$comment: Frontend and backend share this schema, so pattern uses only constructs valid in both runtimes: [0-9] instead of \d (Python \d includes Unicode decimal digits), plus a newline-rejecting not (Python $ also matches before a trailing newline, while ECMA-262 lacks \Z). Also, format is only an annotation by default in jsonschema, and this repository installs no format checker: format is documentation only, and the same field's pattern must enforce constraints. Length limits keep components within integer-conversion bounds so version comparison can always parse validated values.

template.description: String template. Placeholders are variable names inside double braces. A string containing only one placeholder retains the variable's native type; mixed text always stringifies. Whole-string placeholders resolving to null remove their key or array element.

urlTemplate.description: Request URL template: at least one nonwhitespace character. Reject definitions lacking request targets when saving, rather than wait for runtime request failure.

jsonTemplate.description: Structured JSON template: any JSON value, with strings rendered as template; object $each keys and array $each elements expand under eachDirective; object $when is an optional guard.

$when.description: Object-level guard: remove the entire object (array element or key/value pair) when the referenced asset is absent. The value must name a declared input.

eachDirective.description: The sole field-expansion construct. Use item in arrays (expand into elements); use key and value in objects (expand into key/value pairs merged into the containing object). Loop bodies may use the element variable named by as and index (starting at 0). Zero-item expansion removes the containing key or array element.

headerMap.description: Request-header templates. Keys use the HTTP field-name tchar set (RFC 9110 §5.6.2); permit valid characters such as underscores.
headerMap.$comment: Python re `$` also matches before a trailing newline, while ECMA-262 lacks \Z. Since the frontend also uses this schema, add a newline-rejecting not instead of changing anchors.

additionalProperties.description: Header-value templates: no CR/LF. Newlines inside field values start another header and HTTP clients already reject them.

min_app_version.description: Minimum ArcReel version (semver) required to run this definition. If the current application is older, import confirmation warns and market installation rejects.

hints.description: Hints distributed with the definition, displayed and confirmed by the user on import; contain no credentials.

auth.description: Authentication: header names and value templates, or query parameters. api_key placeholders may appear only in this section and nonempty auth must reference one at least once; signature-based authentication is unsupported. The entire section may be an empty object for credential-free interfaces.

source.description: Corresponding asset field in generation requests. Image definitions accept only reference_images.

encoding.description: Asset encoding: data_uri or bare base64. Asset formats are not whitelisted; the provider rejects them on submission.

required.description: Whether this asset is required by this request shape. Default false means optional; required image inputs cause text_to_video to derive as false.

jsonpath.description: Restricted RFC 9535 JSONPath subset: start with $; child segments only; filters allow only @ singular queries, literal comparisons, logical AND, OR, and negation. No recursive descent, unions, slice steps, or function extensions. The validator parses each path; the schema only prefilters.

pathItem.description: Extraction-path item: a JSONPath string, or JSON-in-string suffix form (path plus json_decode plus then). Suffixes do not nest.

json_decode.description: For string matches, parse JSON first, then continue extraction with then. Nonstring matches, decoding failure, or no then match count as no match for this item; proceed to the next.

extractSpec.description: Response extraction: evaluate path items in priority order; the first path with an acceptable match wins, using its first node. Shorthand is the path-item array (accept defaults to string). $ always refers to the parsed response body; HTTP status codes do not use JSONPath.

accept.description: Accepted match types: string (default; skip arrays, objects, null, and numbers), or scalar (strings, numbers, booleans; stringify numbers and booleans for downstream consumers).

url.description: URL template; do not percent-encode placeholder values in paths or queries. Put static and dynamic queries in this template; credential queries belong to auth.query.

extract.description: Any 2xx counts as submission success; no task_id match under a success code means submission failure, with error details extracted through error.

expire_on_404.description: Whether polling 404 during resume immediately marks the job expired. true (default) suits endpoints where 404 definitively means the job no longer exists; use false if running jobs may transiently return 404, retrying as transient errors until the polling budget expires. Affects resume only: initial-generation polling always retries 404 as transient.

extract.description: Polling intervals, timeouts, and transient-error retries are runtime policy, not definition data. Under 2xx, extract state via status; 429 and 5xx retain the previous state and continue polling; other codes fail the job, extracting errors through error.

image_b64.description: Base64 image artifact contents; accept bare base64 and data:image/...;base64, forms. Prefer URL when both this and image_url are specified.

failure.description: Failure criteria beyond the state string: any path yielding an acceptable match means failed; extract error details through error.

result_id.description: Artifact ID for secondary retrieval, referenced by the result section's result_id placeholder.

resultRequest.description: Optional secondary retrieval section: after polling reaches succeeded, issue another request for the artifact. URL templates may use task_id and result_id placeholders.

capabilities.description: Protocol-level capability declarations, the sole capability source. Video fields have the same names and meanings as VideoCapabilities in arcreel_market_core/video_backend_contract.py; model rows retain capability_overrides. The validator checks bidirectional consistency with inputs actually referenced by submit. The whole section may be omitted (all defaults, meaning no asset inputs). Image definitions use text_to_image, image_to_image, and max_reference_images and must declare at least one image capability; declaring image_to_image also requires a reference-image limit and submit references to reference_images assets. Fields form media-type-specific sets checked by the validator.
